scope: BuildKit-compatible local FROM references for shared tool bases and explicit Codex base mode

reportedIssue.source: User deployment report, not a new local Docker acceptance result
reportedIssue.observation: FROM bare sha256 image ID requests a registry and fails; FROM an existing local tag succeeds without network

implementation.verification: Bind from the verified local image ID and inspect the derived tag; reject mismatch or tagging failure
implementation.frozenIdentity: RootImageID, ParentImageID, ImageID, cache keys and lock schemas keep content IDs
implementation.fixedImageMissing: Fail locally; do not pull a bare ID or substitute a movable tag
implementation.dependencies: No new production dependencies; existing Docker builder selection is unchanged

scope: Derived alias repair and identity mismatch
Tag failure, missing fixed root, cancellation
Explicit Codex base: ID for capability checks, verified local tag for FROM

checks.scope: All TestRuntimeImage cases plus the initialization image queue race regression; the command fixture resolves aliases to their exact image IDs
Final source manifest, archive CRC, exact bytes and permission bits

limits: Docker command fixtures reject bare image IDs in FROM and require the local tag to resolve to the expected ID. They do not constitute real BuildKit acceptance.
Real Docker 29.7.2 and the six full built-in recipe builds, offline checks and smoke tests must be rerun on the deployment host.
This fix covers the existing local Docker Engine/default-builder workflow; arbitrary remote or docker-container builders are not validated.
APT, Python/npm and source downloads retain their existing network requirements; avoiding a spurious parent registry lookup does not make the whole build offline.
Old failed build records and frozen contexts are not rewritten. Retrying creates a new build; a removed frozen image must be restored or a new input explicitly selected.
Windows amd64 was cross-compiled, not run on a Windows host.
Optional external integration tests may skip without their service binaries or credentials. Prior Skill and model evidence is not counted as new live acceptance.
